'''Jokko Haning's Emporium''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located in [[Ackbar City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]]. In [[44 ABY]], [[Wraith Squadron]] member [[Myri Antilles]] went to the bar undercover to gather information.<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>
